SELECT listagg(D.COUNTER_NAME, ',') within group ( order by D.COUNTER_NAME ) entrusterName, DT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, DT.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, DT.FINPROD_ID finProdId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FPA.SALE_DEPARTMENT saleChannel, DT.PS ps , FP.PROFIT_TYPE, to_char(DT.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') settleDate, DT.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, DT.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, DT.CCY ccy /*add by yejiejie 2019-4-4 start*/ ,WY.FEE_AMT sdefaultAmt /*add by yejiejie 2019-4-4 end*/ ,decode(DT.IS_CANCEL,'Y','03','01') effectStatus FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_ID = DT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FP.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ PMO ON PMO.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY D ON ','||FP.ENTRUSTER||',' LIKE '%,'||D.COUNTER_ID||',%' /*add by yejiejie 2019-4-4 start*/ left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd on DT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND tpd.PS = 'C18' LEFT JOIN trd_trade_fee_detail WY ON WY.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID /*费用信息*/ AND WY.FEE_TYPE='B18' /*add by yejiejie 2019-4-4 end*/
FPA.ISSUE_STATUS = #{发行成功} AND DT.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND DT.BUSI_TYPE = #{FINPROD15}
AND FP.FINPROD_ID IN (#{item} )
AND DT.SETTLE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startCfmDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND DT.SETTLE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endCfmDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND PMO.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{groupId}
AND DT.PS in (#{item1})
AND DT.IS_CANCEL = decode(#{effectStatus},'03','Y','N')
GROUP BY DT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, DT.PORTFOLIO_ID, DT.FINPROD_ID, FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FPA.SALE_DEPARTMENT, DT.PS, FP.PROFIT_TYPE, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, DT.TRADE_DATE, DT.TRADE_AMT, DT.SHARE_AMT, DT.CCY ,WY.fee_amt ,DT.IS_CANCEL

select A.FINPROD_ID id, A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':' || A.FINPROD_ABBR text, B.SALE_DEPARTMENT, a.CCY, A.PROFIT_TYPE, C.UNITVALUE_DEC,
C.UNITVALUE_MODE, B.PORTFOLIO_ID, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE,B.PROD_REGIST_CODE, B.IS_LAY, B.LAY_TYPE,A.ENTRUSTER, TO_CHAR(A.ACTMDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') prdMdate, TO_CHAR(A.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') prdVdate, listagg(D.COUNTER_NAME, ',') within group ( order by D.COUNTER_NAME ) COUNTER_NAME,B.DEAL_MODE from FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN PRD_VAL_PARAM C on a.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY D ON ','||A.ENTRUSTER||',' LIKE '%,'||D.COUNTER_ID||',%'
A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND B.ISSUE_STATUS = #{ISSUE_STATUS01} AND B.DEAL_MODE IN (#{dealType01}, #{dealType11}, #{dealType10}, #{dealType10})
and (instr(A.FINPROD_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(A.FINPROD_NAME, #{search}) > 0 or instr(A.FINPROD_ABBR, #{search}) > 0)
and A.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue}
and A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{profitType}
group by A.FINPROD_ID,A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME, B.SALE_DEPARTMENT, a.CCY, A.PROFIT_TYPE, C.UNITVALUE_DEC, C.UNITVALUE_MODE,
B.PORTFOLIO_ID,
A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, B.PROD_REGIST_CODE, B.IS_LAY, B.LAY_TYPE, A.ENTRUSTER, A.ACTMDATE, A.VDATE, A.ENTRUSTER, B.DEAL_MODE
select DEPT_NAME text from SYS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CODE = #{search}

SELECT A.indexNo, A.FINPROD_ID, A.remainPrinAmt, A.reduceAmt, A.CUSTOM_LEVEL, A.AMT_MIN, A.AMT_MAX, A.TERM_MAX, A.TERM_MIN, to_char(A.vDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(A.mDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, A.interest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T1.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' then to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE t3.BRANCH || '' END indexNo, T1.FINPROD_ID, T3.remainPrinAmt, T3.remainPrinAmt reduceAmt, T3.interest-NVL(t5.intamt,0) interest, nvl(t4.intdate,T1.VDATE) vDate, TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T2.CUSTOM_LEVEL, T2.AMT_MIN, T2.AMT_MAX, T2.TERM_MAX, T2.TERM_MIN FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT bok.finprod_id, --nvl(f.branch, t.branch) branch, null branch, bok.tdy_prin_amt remainPrinAmt, bok.tdy_unpaid_intincexp interest FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD bok
WHERE bok.cdate = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') -1 and bok.tdy_prin_amt > 0 and bok.finprod_id = #{finprodId}) T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,max(settle_date) intdate from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and settle_date <=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel ='N' or deal.is_cancel is null) group by deal.finprod_id ) T4 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( select deal.finprod_id,sum(deal.trade_amt) intamt from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps = #{C7} and deal.settle_date=TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel ='N' OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL) group by deal.finprod_id )T5 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T1.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) A

SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T2.FINPROD_ABBR, T2.FINPROD_NAME, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T3.SALE_DEPARTMENT, T1.PS, T3.IS_LAY, T3.LAY_TYPE, T2.PROFIT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, TO_CHAR(T1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') SETTLE_DATE, T2.CCY, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SHARE_AMT, t4.prin_amt prinAmt, T1.UNIT_CPRICE, T4.REMARK remark, PT.BRANCH entrusterId, listagg(D.COUNTER_NAME, ',') within group ( order by D.COUNTER_NAME ) entrusterName, /*强减信息*/ T4.TRADE_ID, T4.BRANCH indexNo, T5.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT remainPrinAmt, T4.TRADE_AMT reduceAmt, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T7.CUSTOM_LEVEL, T7.AMT_MIN, T7.AMT_MAX, T7.TERM_MAX, T7.TERM_MIN, T7.PROD_STYLE, t5.THEORY_RATE YIELD, t5.ACT_RATE actYield, t5.BASIS, t5.THEORY_INT interest, t6.INT_AMT actInterest, /*费用信息*/ FEEDEAL.TRADE_ID FEE_TRADEID, FEEDEAL.BRANCH, FEEDEAL.SHARE_AMT, FEE.FEE_NAME, FEE.FEE_TYPE, to_char(FEEDEAL.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') FEE_VDATE, to_char(FEEDEAL.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') FEE_MDATE, FEE.FEE_ID, PAFEE.BASIS FEE_BASIS, PAFEE.THEORY_INT FEE_FEE_AMT, PAFEE.THEORY_RATE FEE_YIELD, PAFEE.ACT_RATE FEE_ACT_YIELD, FEEDEAL.TRADE_AMT FEE_AMT /*add by yejiejie 2019-2-25 start*/ ,PAFEE.customers_Reduce_Num customersReduceNum /*add by yejiejie 2019-2-25 end*/ ,WY.FEE_AMT sdefaultAmt ,T4.REMARK remark FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL PT ON PT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY D ON ','||PT.BRANCH||',' LIKE '%,'||D.COUNTER_ID||',%' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T3 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T4 ON T4.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID/*强减信息*/ AND T4.PS in (#{C17},#{C18})/*强减本金*/ LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T5 ON T4.TRADE_ID = T5.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND T6.PS = #{C15}/*兑付客户收益*/ LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T7 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T7.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL FEEDEAL ON FEEDEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID/*费用信息*/ AND FEEDEAL.ps = #{C11} LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL PAFEE ON PAFEE.TRADE_ID = FEEDEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON FCI.CASH_ID = FEEDEAL.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO FEE ON FCI.FEE_ID = FEE.FEE_ID
LEFT JOIN trd_trade_fee_detail WY ON WY.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID /*费用信息*/ AND WY.FEE_TYPE=#{B18}
WHERE 1=1
and t1.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId} and t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totalTradeId} and T4.FINPROD_ID = t6.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.FINPROD_ID, T2.FINPROD_ABBR, T2.FINPROD_NAME, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T3.SALE_DEPARTMENT, T1.PS, T2.PROFIT_TYPE, T3.IS_LAY, T3.LAY_TYPE, T1.TRADE_DATE, T2.CCY, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.SHARE_AMT, t4.prin_amt, T1.UNIT_CPRICE, T1.REMARK, PT.BRANCH, /*强减信息*/ T4.TRADE_ID, T4.BRANCH, T5.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT, T4.TRADE_AMT, T4.VDATE, T4.MDATE, T7.CUSTOM_LEVEL, T7.AMT_MIN, T7.AMT_MAX, T7.TERM_MAX, T7.TERM_MIN, T7.PROD_STYLE, t5.THEORY_RATE , t5.ACT_RATE , t5.BASIS, t5.THEORY_INT , t6.INT_AMT , /*费用信息*/ FEEDEAL.TRADE_ID , FEEDEAL.BRANCH, FEEDEAL.SHARE_AMT, FEE.FEE_NAME, FEE.FEE_TYPE, FEEDEAL.VDATE, FEEDEAL.MDATE, FEE.FEE_ID, PAFEE.BASIS , PAFEE.THEORY_INT , PAFEE.THEORY_RATE , PAFEE.ACT_RATE , FEEDEAL.TRADE_AMT, PAFEE.customers_Reduce_Num, PAFEE.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT ,WY.FEE_AMT ,T1.SETTLE_DATE,T4.REMARK

SELECT A.indexNo, A.FINPROD_ID, A.remainPrinAmt, A.reduceAmt, A.reduceAmtTher, A.PROD_STYLE, to_char(A.vDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, to_char(A.mDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, A.interest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN T1.OPERATION_TYPE = '01' then to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') ELSE t3.BRANCH || '' END indexNo, T1.FINPROD_ID, T3.tdy_prin_amt-nvl(T6.prinAmt,0) remainPrinAmt, T3.tdy_prin_amt-nvl(T6.prinAmt,0) reduceAmt, T3.tdy_prin_amt-nvl(T6.prinAmt,0) reduceAmtTher, T3.tdy_unpaid_intincexp - NVL(t5.intamt, 0) /*- NVL(t6.intamt, 0)*/ interest, nvl(t4.intdate, T1.VDATE) vDate, TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T2.PROD_STYLE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2
ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.Finprod_Id
ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.p_Finprod_Id
LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID and T3.cdate = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1 /*上一个付息交易*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, max(deal.mdate) intdate from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps in (#{C7}) and deal.mdate <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} or deal.is_cancel is null) group by deal.finprod_id, deal.branch) T4 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID /*减去付息截止日收到的利息*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, sum(deal.INT_AMT) intamt from trd_product_deal deal where deal.ps in (#{C7}, #{C15}) and ( (deal.ps=#{C15} and deal.settle_date = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) or deal.ps=#{C7} and TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') between deal.mdate and deal.settle_date ) and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
and nvl(deal.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null'
and deal.trade_status =#{tradeStatus}
group by deal.finprod_id) T5 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID /*减去当天已赎回的本金 增加到期本金*/ LEFT JOIN (select deal.finprod_id, sum(deal.PRIN_AMT) prinAmt from trd_product_deal deal
where deal.ps in (#{C4},#{C5}) AND NVL(deal.P_TRADE_ID,'null')='null'
and deal.settle_date = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and (deal.is_cancel = #{NO} OR DEAL.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)
and deal.trade_status =#{tradeStatus}
group by deal.finprod_id) T6 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
WHERE
T1.p_Finprod_Id = #{finprodId}
T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND NVL(T3.TDY_PRIN_AMT, 0) != 0 AND T1.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) A

select count(1) from fin_cash_plan fcp inner join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id and fcp.pay_date != fp.mdate where fcp.pay_date = TO_DATE(#{tradeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and fcp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fcp.cash_type = '01'
